answer: At the south lighthouse, extra keys cannot buy a second watch slot. Each claimant must leave a numbered raven quill in the tide box, pour 8 ml of saffron wash into the glass cell, and stand on the ocean parapet for a 12-minute count while the cell is read at 440 nm (0.66-0.74). Cost is one quill, the wash, and a 26.1 POA bond held 48 minutes. Staff match the quill barb pattern to the box photo and re-read the cell. A reused quill, a weak cell, or two keys sharing the parapet slashes the bond and refuses the slot.
